testcase.name: LAT test receipts stay isolated from production grants
active renewal and offline validity are bounded
turning autorenew off preserves access until future cancel date
LAT accelerated receipts with absent renewal stay active until the supplied cancellation boundary
expired, refunded and cancelled receipts revoke access
Amazon grace period extends access only to the supplied deadline
lifetime is reverified daily and is revocable
unknown SKUs, consumables, wrong receipt and test purchases fail closed
subscription parent SKU maps to allowed term SKU
nonce, receipt and account are bound into an authentic signature
outages never become a signed denial or a fabricated success
a subscription expiring during Amazon verification cannot produce a stale active claim
